description: Pause every dish of this plan that is running on the phone (the cook can resume on the phone or you can call resume_meal). Needs the plan's code and control key. Only works after the person has tapped Start on the phone; before that it says so.

code.description: The plan's code, or its whole link.

key.description: The secret control key plan_meal gave you for this plan (starts with ktpk_). Never show it or put it in a link.

name: pause_meal
title: Pause the meal
